findings_qualitative.value: Ten oxygen-bearing COMs robustly identified; N-bearing COMs deficient

claims.hypothesis: Does the inner emission cavity persist in Band 3 where dust is fainter?
claims.experiment: Line profile forward modelling of Keplerian wings
claims.result: Radial profiles depressed inside ~40 au, peaking at ~50–60 au
claims.finding: Inner cavity likely exists in Band 3 (dust absorption and/or chemical destruction)

evidence.quote: the inner emission cavity likely exists even in the Band 3 emission as well.

claims.hypothesis: Are COM abundances in the disk enhanced relative to protostellar envelopes?
claims.result: Ratios higher than IRAS 16293-2422 by a factor >~5–10, similar to 67P

evidence.quote: We found higher abundance ratios of COMs in the V883 Ori disk compared to those in the warm envelopes of IRAS 16293-2422 by a factor of $\gtrsim$ 5–10
The measured $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C ratios are all $\sim$20–30

claims.hypothesis: Are D/H ratios of COMs similar to IRAS 16293B?
claims.finding: Possible destruction and reformation of COMs in disks

evidence.quote: The upper limit of COM D/H ratios obtained in the V883 Ori disk are lower than the ratios in IRAS 16293B.

why_this_data.value: Band 3 has fainter dust continuum, allowing probing of the inner disk; more species and isotopologues

evidence.quote: This necessitates observations at longer wavelengths, where the dust continuum emission is generally expected to be fainter

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: JvM correction rejected in favor of image-plane continuum subtraction

evidence.quote: we mitigate the JvM effect and recover correct flux scale as much as possible by employing the continuum subtraction on the image plane

limitations_admitted.value: Emission only marginally resolved; midplane assumption; CH2DOH spectroscopy uncertain by ~factor 3

evidence.quote: Although the uncertainties of the reconstructed radial intensity profiles are quite large
